title: Sparkly telescope
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='tube' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#7fd4ff'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#2f9fe0'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='tube2' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffe98a'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#f2b134'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- tripod legs -->
  <rect x='47' y='58' width='6' height='30' rx='3' fill='#c98a3b'/>
  <rect x='35' y='60' width='5' height='28' rx='2.5' fill='#e0a94e' transform='rotate(20 37 88)'/>
  <rect x='60' y='60' width='5' height='28' rx='2.5' fill='#e0a94e' transform='rotate(-20 62 88)'/>

  <!-- main tube, tilted up-right -->
  <g transform='rotate(-30 50 45)'>
    <rect x='22' y='34' width='56' height='20' rx='8' fill='url(#tube)'/>
    <!-- tube highlight stripe -->
    <rect x='26' y='38' width='48' height='5' rx='2.5' fill='#bdeaff' opacity='0.7'/>
    <!-- eyepiece end -->
    <rect x='14' y='38' width='12' height='12' rx='4' fill='#9c5bd1'/>
    <rect x='8' y='40' width='8' height='8' rx='3' fill='#c9a0f0'/>
    <!-- aperture / front lens -->
    <ellipse cx='78' cy='44' rx='5' ry='10' fill='url(#tube2)'/>
    <ellipse cx='78' cy='44' rx='3' ry='6' fill='#fff6cf'/>
    <!-- mount clamp -->
    <rect x='44' y='52' width='14' height='8' rx='4' fill='#e0574f'/>
  </g>

  <!-- sparkles -->
  <g fill='#ffe066'>
    <path d='M18 16 l2 5 5 2 -5 2 -2 5 -2 -5 -5 -2 5 -2 z'/>
    <path d='M80 14 l1.6 4 4 1.6 -4 1.6 -1.6 4 -1.6 -4 -4 -1.6 4 -1.6 z'/>
    <path d='M86 34 l1.4 3.5 3.5 1.4 -3.5 1.4 -1.4 3.5 -1.4 -3.5 -3.5 -1.4 3.5 -1.4 z'/>
  </g>
  <g fill='#8ce6ff'>
    <path d='M30 8 l1.3 3.2 3.2 1.3 -3.2 1.3 -1.3 3.2 -1.3 -3.2 -3.2 -1.3 3.2 -1.3 z'/>
    <path d='M70 26 l1.2 3 3 1.2 -3 1.2 -1.2 3 -1.2 -3 -3 -1.2 3 -1.2 z'/>
    <path d='M14 42 l1.2 3 3 1.2 -3 1.2 -1.2 3 -1.2 -3 -3 -1.2 3 -1.2 z'/>
  </g>
  <!-- tiny dot sparkles -->
  <circle cx='48' cy='12' r='1.8' fill='#ffe066'/>
  <circle cx='90' cy='52' r='1.6' fill='#8ce6ff'/>
  <circle cx='22' cy='30' r='1.5' fill='#ffffff'/>
</svg>
